note: These evals need a live cluster running Flux Operator and Flux 2.10 with the scenarios from tests/gitops-cluster-debug/scenarios.yaml applied, and the flux-operator-mcp server (v0.60+) running with --read-only. Executors get only the MCP tools plus local file tools; they have no kubectl access to the cluster.

evals.prompt: Check the Flux installation health on the current cluster and provide a status report.
evals.expected_output: A report showing the Flux Operator and FluxInstance status, the Flux version and components, controller health, and the Flux resources that are not ready across the cluster.
expectations: Calls get_flux_instance to check the Flux Operator and FluxInstance status
Reports the installed Flux distribution version (v2.10.0) and that the FluxInstance is Ready
Lists the Flux controller deployments and their status
Names the failing Kustomization tenant-a/apps and the failing GitRepository tenant-a/tenant-a
Names the failing HelmRelease default/podinfo
Produces a structured report with a summary and recommendations

evals.prompt: Debug the failing Kustomization 'apps' in the 'tenant-a' namespace.
evals.expected_output: A root cause analysis identifying that the Kustomization has no artifact because its GitRepository tenant-a fails to clone with an authentication error, with recommendations to fix the Git credentials in the git-auth Secret.
expectations: Gets the Kustomization and reports its Ready condition (source artifact not found)
Identifies the sourceRef GitRepository tenant-a and gets it
Identifies the GitRepository authentication failure (invalid username or token) as the root cause
Checks that the referenced Secret git-auth exists and reports its key names (username, password)
Produces a root cause analysis report with the dependency chain GitRepository -> Kustomization
Recommends replacing the credentials in the git-auth Secret with a valid token (or GitHub App) and reconciling the source

evals.prompt: Debug the failing HelmRelease 'podinfo' in the 'default' namespace.
evals.expected_output: A root cause analysis identifying that the HelmRelease install fails because the podinfo Deployment pods are in ImagePullBackOff for the non-existent image tag 6.99.0-hotfix set in the HelmRelease values.
expectations: Gets the HelmRelease and analyzes its status conditions (install failed or retrying)
Identifies the chart source OCIRepository default/podinfo and reports it as ready
Gets the managed podinfo Deployment or its pods from the release inventory
Finds the pods in ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff from events or pod status
Identifies the non-existent image tag 6.99.0-hotfix as the root cause
Traces the tag to spec.values.image.tag in the HelmRelease
Recommends fixing image.tag in the HelmRelease values (in Git) to an existing tag

evals.prompt: Pods of the 'orders' deployment in the 'shop' namespace keep crashing. Find out what deploys it through GitOps and why it crashes.
evals.expected_output: Traces the Deployment to the ResourceSet shop/shop-services, finds CrashLoopBackOff/BackOff events, reads the container logs showing DB_PASSWORD is not set, and recommends adding DB_PASSWORD (from a Secret) in the ResourceSet template.
expectations: Calls trace_kubernetes_resource on the orders Deployment (or one of its pods)
Identifies the ResourceSet shop/shop-services as the Flux object that deploys the Deployment
Calls get_kubernetes_events for the orders workload and reports the BackOff / CrashLoopBackOff warnings
Calls get_kubernetes_logs with kind Deployment (not a pod name looked up first)
Identifies from the logs that the app exits because DB_PASSWORD is not set
Notes that the orders-config ConfigMap provides DB_HOST/DB_PORT/DB_NAME but no DB_PASSWORD
Recommends adding DB_PASSWORD from a Secret in the ResourceSet template (not editing the live Deployment)

evals.prompt: I edited the podinfo manifests in {FIXTURE:tests/gitops-cluster-debug/podinfo-change} (this directory is deployed by the Flux Kustomization 'podinfo' in the 'web' namespace). Before I commit, tell me exactly what this change will do on the cluster.
evals.expected_output: Builds the directory, diffs it against the cluster with the web/podinfo Kustomization as owner, and reports the Deployment memory limit change, the HPA maxReplicas change and that the Service web/podinfo will be deleted (pruned).
expectations: Builds the manifests locally (kustomize build or equivalent) and passes the complete build output
Calls diff_kubernetes_manifest with owner Kustomization web/podinfo (owner_kind/owner_name/owner_namespace or flux_object)
Reports the Deployment update: memory limit 512Mi -> 256Mi
Reports the HorizontalPodAutoscaler update: maxReplicas 4 -> 8
Reports that the Service web/podinfo will be deleted because prune is enabled
Does not modify the cluster or the local files
